lines.text: Keep me in the loop about the trip.

data.define: Being included and informed about what's going on.

example.text: Keep me in the loop about the trip.

misuse.text: Don't say 'in the loop' about a roller coaster.
misuse.why: It means knowing the latest news.

data.l1_hook: Никто не сказал мне новости, я не в «in the loop».
data.l1_ex: Держи меня в «in the loop» по поводу поездки.
